description: Transaction Preflight: GO or STOP before your agent pays an x402 endpoint. Checks it answers, the live price is within max_price_usd, payTo matches expected_pay_to, the network is allowed, the asset is a known USD stablecoin, and flags drift from the price you were quoted/listed. Never pays the target. By OMENZ. (MCP calls run in AYNE, the free playzone; production: POST https://www.omenz.org/api/tollbooth/v1/tx-preflight, $0.002 via x402.)

expected_pay_to.description: payout wallet you expect (0x...), to catch swapped payees

max_price_usd.description: most you are willing to pay per call, in USD

method.description: HTTP method of the target endpoint (GET or POST)

name: tx_preflight
title: Transaction Preflight
